description: This PHP script handles displaying and managing related lists for Account records within the vtiger CRM system. It manages entity retrieval, user permissions, session data related to related modules, and displays related lists via Smarty templates.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Class used to handle CRM entity instances, including retrieving entity info.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Subclass of Smarty templating engine customized for vtiger CRM.

classes.name: RelatedListViewSession
classes.description: Class managing session state for related module views.

methods.description: Method to retrieve and populate entity info based on record ID.
